For country and issuer fields, match expected values case-insensitively without adding suffixes or assumptions. Prioritize direct OCR text with explicit normalization rules. Avoid reconstructing or inferring values; use only visible, unambiguous text. Ensure all field values are strings or null, with no invented or assumed data.
